_comment: Pre-registered evaluation protocol. Frozen before the first backtest run; do not adapt to results. Values marked start_value have no evidence behind them.

pandemic_exclusion.reason: Testing, closure and quarantine rules distort the series; not used for baselines, training or scoring.

seasons.definition: ISO week 40 to week 39 of the following year
seasons.test_rule: The test season is evaluated once; `backtest test` refuses to overwrite its result without --force.

vintage_note: Archived data versions (as_of) exist only from the first ingest on. Until enough versions are archived the backtest uses today's corrected data and therefore looks somewhat better than a live forecast would.

models.selection_rule: Feature set with the lowest mean WIS of the ensemble on the tuning seasons; then the spread factor with the lowest ensemble WIS on the tuning seasons.

peak_scoring: Timing (weeks) and height (relative) of the peak of the median forecast versus the actual peak, per region, season and horizon.

gate.evaluated_on: test season, all regions and horizons

external_comparison_note: Pending: requires the archived forecasts of both initiatives; reported as not done until implemented.
